title: Build Presentation from Answers (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Build Presentation from Answers applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Build Presentation from Answers (BtnDocumentAutomation) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Schema recovery and output transaction hardening are pinned by the production Core tests
scenarios.expected: Corrupt stored schema parts fall back to the newest valid version while unsupported newer schema versions are rejected instead of silently downgrading; output writes run through a transaction that keeps the template unchanged on failure; one-based PowerPoint collection traversal treats the COM collections as 1-indexed. These behaviors are already driven by the production tests (33 tests: DocumentAutomationHardeningTests, DocumentAutomationOutputTransactionTests and the DocumentAutomation tests in the catalog test program) used by DocumentAutomationPowerPointService, so this scenario binds the existing runner instead of duplicating it.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
